name: 5b2fac9138da
claim: Before claiming a pin or fingerprint matches nothing, inventory every CA, leaf and token file on disk including backups, worktrees and handoff archives, and maintain a TRUST-INVENTORY.md with one row per credential (DER sha256, path, role, valid-to).

decisions.notes: Two CA certificates with identical subjects existed across the machines and both sides mis-claimed matches from incomplete inventories; the shared inventory resolved it in minutes.

rationale: Incomplete trust inventories produced wrong match-nothing claims on both sides this cycle; the inventory is the antidote.
